This vertical editorial illustration features a caricature of a man in the foreground, positioned from the chest up. He has brown skin, large dark eyes, and a wide, grinning mouth with oversized, prominent white teeth. He wears a white headcloth tied with a knot and a white collared shirt. He holds a dark grey smartphone in his right hand, positioned as if taking a selfie.

Behind him, a light brown tent-like structure sits on a grassy landscape with out-of-focus green trees in the distance. The top of the image features a large red masthead reading "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A red number "53" is to the right. 

Additional text includes: "Tumbangnya Peretail Besar di Era Disrupsi H.78", "Jauh Panggang dari Transisi Energi H.90", and the main headline "HABIS MULYONO TERBITLAH MULYADI". Below this, a block of smaller text begins "Kemunculan Gubernur Jawa Barat Dedi Mulyadi..." and ends with "H.26". The bottom left contains a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "19-25 MEI 2025" and "RP 60.000".
